business.name: Summit Line Roofing
business.tagline: Roof and gutter repair, replacement and care for local homes.

pages.title: Summit Line Roofing | Roof and gutter work, explained plainly
pages.description: Roof and gutter repair, replacement and care for local homes. Request a free roof inspection and get a plain answer about what your roof needs.

sections.heading: Your roof, looked at properly and explained plainly
sections.intro: We repair, replace and look after roofs and gutters on local homes. Start with a free inspection and a straight answer.

aside.heading: What the free inspection covers
points: A walk around the roof and gutters with you
Photos of anything that needs attention
A plain list of what can wait and what cannot

sections.heading: What we do
sections.intro: Three kinds of work. Most homes need one of them, and the inspection tells you which.

items.name: Roof repair
items.summary: Leaks, slipped or broken tiles, worn flashing and storm damage, fixed at the source rather than patched over.

items.name: Roof replacement
items.summary: When repairs stop making sense, we explain why and plan the replacement with you before any work starts.

items.name: Gutters
items.summary: Cleaning, repairs and new runs, so water leaves the roof where it should.

sections.heading: How a job runs
sections.intro: The same steps every time, so you know what happens next.

steps.title: You ask for an inspection
steps.text: Fill in the short form or call in the morning. We arrange a time that suits you.

steps.title: We look and explain
steps.text: We check the roof and gutters, take photos and talk you through what we found.

steps.title: You get a written scope
steps.text: A plain description of the work, which package it falls under, and what it does not cover.

steps.title: We do the work
steps.text: On the agreed day, tidily, and we show you the finished job before we leave.

quotes.text: They showed me photos of the actual problem before suggesting anything. The repair was small and that is what they did.
Clear about what could wait and what could not.
The gutters drain properly now and the yard was left clean.

sections.heading: Not sure what your roof needs?
sections.text: Start with the free inspection. You get a plain answer and decide from there.

pages.title: Services and packages | Summit Line Roofing
pages.description: Roof repair, roof replacement and gutter work, grouped into three packages: Repair, Replace and Care.

sections.heading: Services in detail
sections.intro: What each kind of work involves, so you can follow the inspection report.

items.name: Roof repair
items.summary: We find where water is getting in and fix that point, whether it is a tile, flashing around a chimney, or a valley.
details: Leak tracing from inside and out

items.name: Roof replacement
items.summary: If the roof is past repair, we show you why, then agree the materials, the dates and the clean-up before starting.
details: Gutters checked at the same time

items.name: Gutters
items.summary: Blocked or sagging gutters send water into walls and foundations. We clean, repair or replace them.

items.name: Routine checks
items.summary: A look at the roof and gutters on a regular basis, so small problems are caught while they are small.

sections.heading: Three packages
sections.intro: Every job falls under one of these. The inspection tells you which one, and the written scope says exactly what it covers.

tiers.name: Repair
tiers.goodFor: A leak, damaged tiles or worn flashing on a roof that is otherwise sound.
tiers.scope: We fix the problem at its source and check the surrounding area.
includes: A check of nearby tiles and flashing

tiers.name: Replace
tiers.goodFor: A roof that is past repair or failing in several places.
tiers.scope: We remove the old roof and fit a new one, planned with you before work starts.

tiers.name: Care
tiers.goodFor: Homes that want small problems caught early.
tiers.scope: Regular checks of the roof and gutters, with photos and a short note after each visit.

sections.note: Prices are agreed after the inspection, once the scope is written down.

sections.heading: Find out which package fits
sections.text: The free inspection comes first. Nothing is agreed until you have the written scope.

pages.title: Common questions | Summit Line Roofing
pages.description: Plain answers about inspections, packages, booking and what happens on the day.

items.q: What happens at the free inspection?
items.a: We look at the roof and gutters, take photos of anything that needs attention, and explain what we found. You get a plain list of what can wait and what cannot.

items.q: Do I have to book work after the inspection?
items.a: No. The inspection is free and you decide afterwards.
Use the request form or call. The phone is answered in the mornings; if you use the form, we call you back to arrange a time.

items.q: How is the price worked out?
items.a: After the inspection we write down the scope of the work, and the price is agreed against that scope before anything starts.
Repair for a specific problem on a sound roof, Replace when the roof is past repair, and Care for regular checks. The inspection tells you which one fits.

sections.heading: Still have a question?
sections.text: Ask it when you request the inspection, or call in the morning.

pages.title: Request a free roof inspection | Summit Line Roofing
pages.description: Request a free roof inspection. Tell us what you need and a good time of day, and we call you back to arrange it.

sections.heading: Request a free roof inspection
sections.intro: Tell us a little about the roof and when suits you. We call back to arrange a time.
sections.formNote: We call you back to arrange a time. The phone is answered in the mornings.

sections.heading: What happens after you send it
paragraphs: We call you back to agree a time for the inspection. On the day we look at the roof and gutters with you and take photos.
Afterwards you get a written scope of any work we suggest. Nothing starts until you have read it and agreed.

aside.heading: Calling instead?
aside.text: The phone is answered in the mornings. Outside those hours, the form is the quickest way to reach us.

openQuestions: Should package prices be shown, as ranges, or not at all? The client's messages disagree.
Which booking method is real: online time slots, a form the office calls back on, or phone only? The site uses the form plus phone and does not imply a live calendar.
